_what: cv05 (validation/crossval/05_patch_antenna.py) PART-1 ring-down spectra, recorded straight out of the production harminv() call by a runpy harness that patches ONLY rfx.Box's x extent for the patch conductor -- so the realized resonant length differs from the declaration while f_resonance_an and every other declared constant stay at L = 29.5 mm. This is the realization/declaration mismatch class the anchored `argmin |f - f_analytic|` selector could not gate. Modes are the script's own filter: Q > 2 and amplitude > 1e-8, harminv band 1.5-3.5 GHz.
_settling: EVERY run below is UNDER-SETTLED (-21.5 dB baseline, bar -40 dB) -- cv05 prints that witness and does not gate it. These frequencies are therefore identification evidence, not accuracy evidence, and no accuracy claim may be read from them.

_realized_x_cell_census._what: patch x-extent rasterization measured from the geometry mask on cv05's own grid (dx = 1 mm), no FDTD: declared length -> realized x cells. Establishes which design-mode errors are reachable.
